WITH canceled_orders AS (
  SELECT
    LEFT(o.order_id, 10) AS order_id_10,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_approved_at IS NULL THEN 'payment'
      WHEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NULL THEN 'packing'
      WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL THEN 'in_transit'
      ELSE 'delivered'
    END AS cancellation_stage,
    CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS cancellation_timestamp,
    CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS carrier_pickup_timestamp
  FROM orders AS o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'canceled'
)
SELECT
  co.cancellation_stage AS cancellation_stage,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.order_id_10) AS canceled_order_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN co.cancellation_timestamp IS NOT NULL
     AND co.carrier_pickup_timestamp IS NOT NULL
     AND co.cancellation_timestamp < co.carrier_pickup_timestamp
    THEN co.order_id_10
    ELSE NULL
  END) AS canceled_before_carrier_pickup_count,
  CAST(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN co.cancellation_timestamp IS NOT NULL
       AND co.carrier_pickup_timestamp IS NOT NULL
       AND co.cancellation_timestamp < co.carrier_pickup_timestamp
      THEN co.order_id_10
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS DOUBLE
  ) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT co.order_id_10), 0) AS canceled_before_carrier_pickup_pct
FROM canceled_orders AS co
GROUP BY
  co.cancellation_stage
ORDER BY
  canceled_order_count DESC,
  co.cancellation_stage ASC;
